title: Bitcoin Lender Ledn Moves US Clients Onshore With New Custody Accounts
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin Lender Ledn Moves US Clients Onshore With New Custody Accounts Bitcoin lender Ledn launched a US custody account that lets clients hold bitcoin, gold, stablecoins and dollars, with no trading fees and a 0.5% spread. This post Bitcoin Lender Ledn Moves US Clients Onshore With New Custody Accounts first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
